name: Cartesia
desc: Speech API engineered for real-time voice agents under 100ms.
desc_zh: 为实时语音智能体设计的语音 API，延迟低于 100 毫秒。
solves: Voice agents sound broken because speech generation is too slow. It starts speaking in under 100 milliseconds.
solves_zh: 语音 Agent 听起来很生硬，是因为语音生成太慢。它在 100 毫秒内就开始说话。
best_for: When you are building a voice agent that must answer without an audible pause.
best_for_zh: 做语音 Agent，而且要求回答时听不出停顿的时候。
notes: The default build choice when latency is the binding constraint — the bar every other voice API is measured against. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.cnblogs.com/Agora/p/18700753
